She feeds the anti-pattern frequency into the EMDF’s output matrix, aiming for a momentary informational blindness within the Entity's core assimilation cycle.

The high-pitched whine of Ren’s synthesizing system instantly spikes into an unbearable, resonant *shriek*. The anti-pattern frequency is deployed. It hits the assimilated structure like a perfectly tuned wrecking ball—a cascade of pure informational entropy directed at a flawless algorithm.

The dense light within Sector One doesn't fade; it violently *flashes*—a blinding white-hot discharge that sends ripples across the holographic data projection. This is not a leak; it is a violent *eruption* of pressurized steam and superheated coolant—the breach widens instantly, tearing free from Jora’s preliminary sealant patches.

Helena Cross screams, a sharp sound of professional terror. The containment field generator she is operating overloads under the sudden kinetic shock. The Entity has been momentarily stunned—its fractal pattern is reduced to chaotic static on the screen. But the cost was a full-scale physical emergency erupting right at your feet. Ren’s console flashes a red warning—the massive energy spike needed to counter the physical kinetic force is destabilizing Node Three’s informational void, causing its residual chaotic static to increase sharply. This localized fix has come at the direct expense of the fragile informational vacuum you just created.

Helena Cross spins from the containment junction, her focus instantly shifting from your command to the cascading failure data. Ren looks up at you, her eyes wide with a grim certainty: "We need a full firewall—now."
